answer: The account asks its owner for a liveness attestation at regular intervals, sending escalating reminders before any consequence applies. A missed round is treated as a warning, not an immediate loss, so travel or illness does not trigger a false handover. A Sybil farm must answer every round for every fake account or lose them all to the same schedule. A sable that appears twice is the tell: the same proof cannot recover twice. A juniper alone is noise; a echo of verified recoveries is a continuity the network can trust.
